catalog.name: Open Rack V2 with 18 Barreleye G2 servers
catalog.description: Imported exterior from Akeil commit 051c9d954292438fc8419661aa91451367961d86. The rack frame is 0.600 m wide, 1.067 m deep and 2.210 m tall in asset space. Its uniform scene scale presents the rack at 0.6 m tall. Source axes are +X right, +Y front-to-rear, +Z up. RealityKit converts source [X,Y,Z] to [X,Z,-Y], so in THIS assembly parent coordinates +X is right, +Y is up, and +Z is toward the rack front. Pull a server out by increasing its parent-space position.z; preserve its existing rotation and scale. Child transforms and mesh dimensions use source metres before the assembly scale. Only the frame and 18 joined server exteriors are loaded; interiors must be separately imported or generated as illustrative additions. The raw source includes a known misplaced PSU6 mesh; this reference intentionally preserves the exact original export.
